exposure: temporary loop ligation of the infrarenal abdominal aorta
cohort: 14 patients with pernicious placenta previa who underwent temporary loop ligation of the infrarenal abdominal aorta during cesarean section between July 2013 and December 2014
finding: Temporary loop ligation of the infrarenal abdominal aorta during cesarean section in patients with pernicious placenta previa was found to be safe and effective in controlling intraoperative hemorrhage and may help preserve fertility.
